name: android-device-lock
description: Serialize any Android device test runs with a device-side adb file lock.

interface.shortDescription: Serialize any Android tests on a shared device.
interface.longDescription: Acquire a device-side adb file lock before any Android device test run, regardless of test framework, so only one test controls a physical device or emulator at a time.
defaultPrompt: Add a device lock around this Android device test command.
Serialize these Android device tests so one device only runs one suite at a time.
Use adb to wait for an existing device lock before starting tests.
Show device lock ownership and lease expiry.
